allowed: independent re-derivation of the registered Phase 6 WP2 ladder comparisons from committed row bytes
a diagnostic ranking of persisted observable and error-source pairs under the rules frozen here
an explicit inventory of fields unavailable for a future target-specific observation operator
forbidden: a new solver run or replay
a numerical-convergence or accuracy claim beyond the registered ladder scope
a robust-habit claim from the all-neutral historical comparison sides
a target-facing laboratory score or quantitative-validation claim
rewriting, relabeling, or inheriting a verdict from Phase 6 evidence

rows.role: sole scientific-data input for independent re-derivation

historicalReport.role: cross-check only; no verdict or comparison value is inherited

disallowedAuthority.reason: its post-execution top-level some aggregation is weaker than the registered all-spacings rule

rowSchema.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines with one object per non-empty line and a required terminal newline

expectedRowIds.encoding: rowId values sorted by Unicode code point, UTF-8 encoded, one per line, terminal LF

expectedEnumeration.enumerationOrder: domain spacing group, domainN, check point, arm; then auxiliary control, check point, arm
expectedEnumeration.operandEchoRule: each row must equal its independently enumerated tempC, fraction, sigmaInfinity, paramSet, dxUm, seedRadius, targetExtent, domainN, cflFill, relaxTol, fixedEveryRow block, and derived seedThickness exactly

domainRows.construction: two registered spacing groups times three registered domain rungs times four registered check points times two registered arms

auxiliaryRows.construction: four registered controls times four registered check points times two registered arms

identity.encoding: kind|rowIdA|rowIdB values sorted by Unicode code point, UTF-8 encoded, one per line, terminal LF

domainComparisons.construction: within each domainSpacingGroup, compare each domainN with the next domainN in listed order at every check point and arm; this yields sixteen comparisons per spacing and both successive increments

auxiliaryComparisons.construction: each auxiliary row is compared with dom-0.35-n96 at the same check point and arm

orientation.rowIdA: registered reference row: lower domain rung or base auxiliary row
orientation.rowIdB: registered comparison row: next domain rung or varied auxiliary row

explicitlyForbidden: exact crystallographic spans or axis calipers
per-cycle attachment coordinates or orbit witnesses
kinetic, clipping, hole-fill, or vapor ledgers
relaxation residual, divergence, or smoother-drift histories
any future B-defined observation operator not independently derivable from the allowed fields
fieldPolicy.forbiddenFieldHandling: emit an explicit unavailable-field refusal; never estimate, impute, or infer it

registeredHabitClassifier.invalid: aspectRatio is not a finite number or is less than or equal to zero
registeredHabitClassifier.plate: valid aspectRatio less than or equal to the binary64 result of 1 / 1.5, which is 0.6666666666666666
registeredHabitClassifier.column: valid aspectRatio greater than or equal to 1.5

registeredAttachedCountRule.zeroDenominator: artifact defect because a comparable reference attachedCount must be a positive safe integer
registeredAttachedCountRule.passOperator: relative difference less than or equal to maximumInclusive

comparability.attachedCount: positive safe integer for both rows

comparisonRules.comparisonPass: both rows are comparable, their registered habit classes are identical, and the registered attached-count rule passes
comparisonRules.failureClassFold: no failures yields null; one distinct class yields that class; more than one distinct class or any mixed input yields mixed
comparisonRules.artifactDefectEffect: forces every spacing and the overall verdict to no-pass

provenanceRules.heavyRowRule: a heavy row must not carry f59d18702301155c0c2e7eaecc3442e6cf117123
provenanceRules.unexpectedOrMalformedHead: artifact defect that forces every spacing and the overall verdict to no-pass

aggregationRules.domainWithinSpacing: every registered successive-domain comparison for that spacing passes
aggregationRules.spacingPass: domainWithinSpacing and auxiliaryWithinSpacing and no artifact defect
aggregationRules.implementationRequirement: use an all-spacings/every reduction; any-spacing/some aggregation is forbidden

diagnosticNormalization.appliesTo: ranked numerical observables and separate cost diagnostics only
diagnosticNormalization.formula: scale = max(abs(rowIdA value), abs(rowIdB value)); normalizedAbsoluteDelta = scale === 0 ? 0 : abs(rowIdB value - rowIdA value) / scale
diagnosticNormalization.zeroDenominator: both values zero yields exactly 0; one zero and one nonzero yields exactly 1
diagnosticNormalization.nonFiniteValue: artifact defect; the pair receives no rank and the omission is reported
diagnosticNormalization.rounding: no rounding before aggregation or ordering; display formatting is non-authoritative
diagnosticNormalization.stopReason: categorical disagreement is 0 for equality and 1 for inequality and is reported outside the numerical ranking

pairingToErrorSourceMap.authority: normative and exhaustive for all 64 registered pairings
pairingToErrorSourceMap.derivationBasis: derive kind, control name, spacing, domain step, and varied operands independently from pairingGraph plus roster.expectedEnumeration; never trust a producer-emitted errorSourceId or a mutated row operand
pairingToErrorSourceMap.matchCardinality: exactly one rule must match each registered pairing

match.allOtherIndependentRosterOperands: equal except derived values that depend on the varied operand
equal except derived values that depend on the varied operand
equal; seedThickness is the registered derived value 2 * seedRadius + 1 and is not a second error source

pairingToErrorSourceMap.matchSemantics: all fields in one rule's match object are conjunctive; variants are an exact disjunction of their complete objects; substring, prefix-only, producer-field, or first-match classification is forbidden
pairingToErrorSourceMap.countInvariant: the five disjoint buckets contain exactly 16, 16, 8, 8, and 16 pairings respectively and their union is exactly pairingGraph.identity
pairingToErrorSourceMap.producerRequirement: derive and emit errorSourceId using this map and refuse analysis if a pairing has zero or more than one match
pairingToErrorSourceMap.independentEvaluatorRequirement: ignore every emitted errorSourceId, independently reconstruct the registered pairing and expected operands, reapply all five rules, require exactly one match, and compare the derived ID with the emitted ID
pairingToErrorSourceMap.rejection: an unmapped pairing, multiply mapped pairing, bucket-count mismatch, or emitted/derived ID mismatch is an artifact defect; it forces every spacing and overall to no-pass and excludes that pairing from every numerical and cost rank

rankingRules.unit: one allowed numerical observable crossed with one errorSourceGroup
rankingRules.noDefinedComparisons: when definedCount is zero, maxNormalizedAbsoluteDelta and maxWitnessPairId are null and the unit sorts after every unit with a finite maximum
rankingRules.maxWitnessTie: choose the pairing identity that sorts first by Unicode code point among equal raw binary64 maxima
order: units with finite maxNormalizedAbsoluteDelta before units with null maxNormalizedAbsoluteDelta
ascending observableId by Unicode code point
ascending errorSourceId by Unicode code point
rankingRules.ties: the complete order above is authoritative; no wall time, report order, or rounded display value breaks a tie
rankingRules.costSeparation: wallSeconds and peakRssBytes use the same normalization and order in a separately labeled execution-cost table and never enter the numerical-observable rank
rankingRules.costLimit: cost diagnostics retain host, engine, gitHead, and concurrency and cannot establish numerical convergence
rankingRules.habitLimit: habit-class mismatch counts are reported only as the historical registered criterion; neutral-only sides do not become a robust-habit rank

conformance.numbers: finite JSON numbers only; integer contracts additionally require safe integers
conformance.jsonEncoding: UTF-8, two-space canonical JSON, terminal LF
conformance.jsonlEncoding: one compact exact-key JSON object per LF-terminated line; blank lines and CR bytes reject
conformance.arrayRule: arrays described as sorted unique are ordered by Unicode code point and contain no duplicates
conformance.nullRule: null is forbidden except where the applicable schema names it explicitly

fieldContracts.sha256: lower-case 64-hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes

invariants: rowId equals the enclosing rowIdA or rowIdB as applicable
the snapshot contains no field from fieldPolicy.explicitlyForbidden

unavailable requires null normalizedAbsoluteDelta and non-null unavailableReason

noPassClass is null and reasons is empty exactly when verdict is pass
